notes.title: Update Notes for 2024-05-15
notes.notes:
- Completely reworked system for pushing away from rocks and the riverbank.
- The game detects if the player is stuck or out of the river and provides an option to teleport back into the river.
- A safety system that detects extreme accelerations caused by physical glitches and prevents the player from flying away from the level.

notes.title: Update Notes for 2024-05-09
notes.notes:
- Initial telemetry support for Sim Racing Studio.
- Available telemetry data: Yaw / Pitch / Roll.

notes.title: Update Notes for 2024-05-07
notes.notes:
Leaderboard bugfixes:

- On the mode selection screen, the leaderboard shows the top 3 times.
- Upon finishing, the leaderboard displays the player's best time in comparison to other players with similar times.
- Player name is highlighted on the leaderboards.

notes.title: Update Notes for 2024-05-03
notes.notes:
- Both left and right controllers can be used to navigate the menu.
- Bugfix: Paddles getting stuck under the kayak.
- Bugfix: No effect if both sides of the paddles are submerged, which may prevent unwanted physics glitches.
- Height offset can now be set within a wider range.

notes.title: Update Notes for 2024-05-02
notes.notes:
- The tutorial is NOT mandatory; players can start with other game modes
- Tutorial lessons can be completed without collecting all the crates. 
- Bugfix: The Time Attack medium difficulty level does not unlock after completing Desert Canyon in Free Ride mode.

notes.title: Whitewater VR is now available to play!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837529/75675998e742521e4ebdb7a3d339a538fb003f78.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

I'm excited to share that my first game, Whitewater VR - Extreme Kayaking Adventure, is now live on Steam. It's been an incredible journey bringing this game to life, and I couldn't be more excited to share it with you all.

I want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who has supported me along the way. 
Your encouragement and feedback have been invaluable, and I'm incredibly grateful for each and every one of you.

I hope you'll enjoy diving into Whitewater VR and experiencing the adventure firsthand.

Happy kayaking!

Warm regards,
Adam Horvath

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Demo release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837529/0f8e5155044e30ed4f69143319a6bd54f4c7fb53.png[/img]

I am happy to announce that Whitewater VR: Extreme Kayaking Adventure is taking part in 
Steam Next Fest from February 5th-12th!

Steam Next Fest gives developers a chance to show off playable demos of their upcoming games. 
To celebrate this event, I’ve released a playable demo of the "Spring Mountain" level, so you can try out the game for the first time.

To get started go to the game’s main Steam page and click on the download demo link!
The demo will be available for download until the end of the fest. 

Thank you, and have fun!

notes.title: Environments showcase
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

After months of hard work, today I am thrilled to break the silence and show some new content. 

Let me introduce five unique hand crafted environments. Each level has been designed to deliver a heart-pounding vr kayaking experience, pushing players to test their skills as they navigate treacherous waters and thrilling terrain.

[b]Spring Mountain[/b]

[i]As the snow melts and spring blooms in the mountains, paddle through crystal-clear streams, glide past towering peaks, and navigate through exhilarating rapids as springtime comes to life in this level. Experience the thrill of high-altitude kayaking like never before.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837529/596d83dd7b9cae00227a75adbf8b680538746c08.png[/img]

[b]Tropical Jungle[/b]

[i]Embark on an expedition into the heart of a tropical jungle, where ancient ruins lie hidden amidst lush foliage and meandering rivers. Paddle through dense canopies, discover long-forgotten temples, and encounter the mysteries of a lost civilization.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837529/4af36404947414501671c75f6ac701a1721f5994.png[/img]

[b]Eastern Iceland[/b]

[i]Dive into a virtual world where the stunning landscapes of Iceland become your playground. Feel the rush of the arctic wind and the thrill of conquering untamed waters. Get ready to experience Iceland's breathtaking beauty in a whole new way.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837529/d6acc5d0bf4d4672f5625449455daa3890607e5a.png[/img]

[b]Desert Canyon[/b]

[i]Prepare to explore towering rock formations, navigate challenging rapids, and uncover the hidden wonders in the heart of the canyon's wild beauty. Brace yourself for an intense adventure as you navigate the fiery landscapes of the red canyon, where crimson cliffs and thrilling rapids await.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837529/909811c2d2f9ef100432ebe95fe102fe105b05d0.png[/img]

[b]Alpine Valley[/b]

[i]Venture deep into lush valleys and blooming wilderness, and tackle exhilarating mountain rapids as springtime comes to life in this level. Feel the spray of crystal-clear waters and the warmth of the sun on your face![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837529/94931c47699f6760bf063b98d6b2a2868a6a42b9.png[/img]

Don't forget to check out the new screenshots, and gameplay trailers for each new environment. 

Stay tuned for more updates in the upcoming days!

Kind Regards,
Adam Horvath
